title: Native adapter falsely faults on live byval argument copies
description: Dialect §17.1 live-object access and §17.7 native comparison require valid LLVM byval parameter copies to remain live for the callee. Published runtimes scripts/native-check currently instruments loads from byval objects without registering those implicit callee-local stack copies. Real offline-generated f32 powi i7/i193 _rm arithmetic strict links now resolve fenv and exact heap alignment, but native execution faults7 in pack.6(ptr byval(%struct.V), ptr byval(%struct.Format), ...). GDB of the preserved checked binary identifies a 4-byte valid field load in pack+78; checked IR contains no stack registration at that byval-only callee entry. Reduced own fixture .tmp/sol-driver-queue/tmp/byval-probe/device.ll has %S={i64,i64,i64}, caller alloca/store17, exported noinline read_value(ptr byval(%S)); expected status0, actual LLVM18 O0 and O2 both trap with bennett runtime fault7. Persistent arithmetic/gdb receipts are under the directory named in .tmp/sol-driver-queue/arith-layout-path. New tests/native_byval.py/.rs require valid O0/O2 on LLVM18/23 and remain failing; no disabled checks or adjusted numeric expectations. Producer must register exact DataLayout extent/lifetime of implicit byval objects and balance frame tracking on all exits, preserving caller copies, full range checks and identity. Cross-repo request queued in .tmp/sol-driver-queue/cross-repo-beads.md for orchestrator per COMMON14. q4d numerical acceptance and i0v full native detection depend on producer repair.
notes: Final reduced regression FAIL confirmed both majors at both O0/O2: four exact false faults7, 17.86s. Command: timeout 240 cargo test --offline -j4 --test native_byval -- --nocapture --test-threads=4. Producer request appended to .tmp/sol-driver-queue/cross-repo-beads.md per COMMON14. No sibling DB write attempted and no checks disabled.
